jobs.description:
As Business Controller, you will act as a trusted business partner within our Biscuits & Bakery business unit, providing data-driven insights and recommendations to drive profitability, operational excellence, and sustainable growth across our international operations. 
 

About the job
 
 

• Analyze business performance, identify risks and opportunities, and provide recommendations to improve profitability and operational efficiency. 

• Collaborate closely with Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain and Operations teams to deliver clear commercial and operational analyses that support strategic decision-making. 

• Drive the monthly management reporting, ensuring the accuracy of financial results, KPIs, and performance insights across the business unit. 

• Play a key role in the annual budgeting and transfer pricing processes by challenging assumptions, validating business cases, and monitoring financial impact of investments. 

• Evaluate and support strategic initiatives such as CAPEX investments, new product launches, and cost-saving projects through thorough financial analysis. 

• You report directly to the Finance Director Biscuits & Bakery. 

To be able to achieve the above and be successful in this role we believe you need to have:
 
 

• A Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Business Engineering, or a related field. 

• At least 5 years of experience in Finance, Business Controlling, or a similar analytical role. 

• Advanced Excel skills, experience with SAP is considered a strong asset. 

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build strong relationships, influence decision-making, and challenge stakeholders constructively. 

• Fluency in English, with the ability to translate complex financial data into clear, actionable insights for a wide range of business stakeholders.

jobs.occupation: Lead Contract Engineer Nuclear Pressure Equipment (M/F/X)
jobs.description:
As a Lead Contract Engineer (M/F/X), you will be the point of contact for our customers. You build a relationship of trust with the customer and provide tailored advice for the assessment of the construction/design of nuclear pressure equipment according to various construction codes and standards. You maintain regular contact with your customers and also carry out inspections yourself. You are responsible for following up projects from A to Z, from quotation and design through to actual execution and invoicing. In addition, you are also the point of contact for the inspectors on site.
  
 
  
You can always rely on your colleagues: driven experts who are happy to help you further.
  
Vinçotte also supports you in deepening and broadening your expertise. We start this on your very first day, as you will first receive thorough training and an internship before working independently.

  
• Degree: You have a Master's degree in Industrial Sciences – Electromechanics. A Welding Engineer degree is a strong asset.  
• Experience: You preferably have around five years of experience in the maintenance/inspection of pressure equipment.  
• Skills:  
•      
• You are eager to learn and keep up to date with trends and developments in your field.   
• You have a sense of quality and an eye for detail.   
• You show initiative and enjoy customer contact.   
• You work independently and in a disciplined manner.   
• You speak fluent Dutch or French and have a good knowledge of English (both written and spoken).    
• You are communicative and entrepreneurial, with a sense of initiative and organization.

CLdN is a leading provider of integrated quay-to-quay and door-to-door logistics solutions. Founded in 1929, CLdN ensures reliable, cost-effective transport that links the major economic areas of Europe. With 30 ships and more than 200 sailings a week, CLdN provides shortsea connections between the European continent, the United Kingdom, Ireland, Iberia and Scandinavia and offers the lowest CO2 footprint of all Western European RoRo operators. CLdN’s cargo and multimodal services have a Europe-wide reach using CLdN’s extensive network of ships, terminals and equipment. CLdN’s 3,000 employees ensure that it fulfills its mission: to excel as an integrated provider of maritime links.  
 

Are you looking for the next step in your payroll career?

At 
World of Tents in Ronse, we design, develop and supply shelter solutions and crisis response equipment for organisations operating in some of the world's most demanding environments.
 

Our brands 
ALPINTER and SHIELD, support humanitarian organisations, governments, defence and emergency response teams with reliable products designed to perform when it matters most. To strengthen our Quality team, we are looking for a QHSE Specialist who combines an eye for detail with a hands-on mindset and a passion for continuous improvement in product and performance.
 

WHAT WILL YOU DO? 
As our Quality Management Officer, you contribute to the appropriate quality and reliability of our products, from raw materials to finished solutions. Working closely with our QHSE Manager, WOT Teams, international suppliers and external specialist stakeholders, you combine 
quality management processes, QA/QC coordination with our manufacturing partners and product testing, in a practical & problem-solving manner.
 

Here's where you will make a difference:
 

1. Quality Management & compliance
 
 

• Maintain and improve our Quality Management Systems (QMS), supporting ISO 9001 & 14001 compliance, internal & external audits and QA/QC procedures. 

• Identify opportunities to improve operational processes, product quality and sustainability. 

• Support Product Development and Supply Chain colleagues in Quality related aspects of their work  

2. Product Quality & Testing
 
 

• Define quality requirements and testing procedures for raw materials and finished products,  

• Coordinate product testing for core items such as tents, core relief items and other shelter-related equipment, together with internal teams and external laboratories. 

• Analyse test results, identify risks and translate findings into practical improvements.  

3. Customer & Supplier Quality
 
 

• Ensure our products meet customer specifications and quality expectations. 

• Investigate quality complaints, identify root causes and coordinate corrective actions with the teams involved. 

• Monitor incoming goods and supplier quality, following up on inspection reports and quality issues.  

4. Processes & Sustainability
 
 

• Develop, review and audit standard operating procedures and production controls. 

• Identify opportunities to improve process efficiency, consistency and sustainability in collaboration with the QHSE Manager.  

You work closely with our Quality Officer, who provides practical support during product inspections and testing, and report directly to the QHSE Manager.

We'd love to hear from you! Send your CV to jobs@wot.group.
